duplicate RECORD KEY clauses in A-FAIRE SELECT

purpose.domain_detail: French academic exercise involving a cycling race management system (grands tours: Tour de France, Giro, Vuelta) with indexed files for runners, weeks, and civility codes.
purpose.summary: A student COBOL program (F0) for a cycling race management application. It defines indexed file structures for runners (COUREUR), weeks (SEMAINE), tasks (A-FAIRE), and civility (CIVILITE), then implements a menu-driven procedure to display runners not participating in a selected grand tour. The program is incomplete and mixes pseudocode SQL comments with actual COBOL statements.

notable_features: Indexed sequential file organization with multiple ALTERNATE RECORD KEYs
Non-standard // comment style throughout PROCEDURE DIVISION
Bare SQL SELECT statements embedded directly in PROCEDURE DIVISION (not EXEC SQL)
Duplicate RECORD KEY declarations in A-FAIRE SELECT (syntax error)
No PERFORM or CALL statements; no structured flow control
verdict.notes: The file contains significant syntax errors: duplicate RECORD KEY in SELECT A-FAIRE, bare SQL statements without EXEC SQL wrappers, // comments which are non-standard COBOL, and 'JOUR DATE' as a PIC clause. This is clearly a student draft/design document rather than compilable code. The author is identified as 'G3' suggesting a student group. Written in French, dated 2016.
